Name: Calico Statue Spotter
Author: wronque
Description:
Ever been on a large floor of the skull cavern during the desert festival and wondered if it's worth checking every corner of the map to find a calico statue? Well, this mod gives you a pop-up message if the current floor has a calico statue. That way, you don't have to waste time searching for one.

There is translation support for the pop-up message.

This mod is made for Stardew 1.6, and requires SMAPI 4.0.0 or higher.
